summary: This video details the mechanics and reward structure of the Dragonheir 3rd Anniversary Support Event. Players choose between two factions, Child of Chaos or Dark Lady, and bind two creators from their chosen side to earn reputation and lottery draw entries. Faction choice determines the prize pool, while individual activity, spending, and bound creator rankings determine lottery draw counts. Faction selection and creator bindings are permanent once confirmed, requiring players to plan ahead. Maintaining daily in-game activity and watching eligible creator content are key to maximizing rewards.
tips: Verify your favorite creator's faction before locking your choice, as faction choice cannot be changed later.
Complete creator bindings early so all subsequent in-game activity and spending contribute reputation to your bound creators.
Play daily to maximize event activity points, which cap at 2,000 reputation per day.
Watch eligible anniversary content to earn 100 reputation per view with no daily cap.
Select creators expected to stay active and rank high, as higher creator rankings award extra lottery draws to their bound supporters.
title: Choose Wisely! Dragonheir Factions, Creators & Rewards Explained | Dragonheir: Silent Gods
